```{r ddm-paths-and-imports}
# Single source of truth for all DDM results paths and data imports
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(rlang)

# Define paths from params
run_dir <- params$run_dir
tables_dir <- file.path(run_dir, "tables")
summaries_dir <- file.path(run_dir, "summaries")
logs_dir <- file.path(run_dir, "logs")

# Set primary analysis choices
PRIMARY_THR <- 0.20
PRIMARY_RT <- "probe_onset_locked"
PRIMARY_MODEL <- "additive"
PRIMARY_RT_PRETTY <- "probe-onset-locked"   # For inline prose (no script-style names)
PRIMARY_MODEL_PRETTY <- "Additive"          # For inline prose (capitalized)

# Display labels for manuscript-ready tables (avoid script-style variable names)
format_rt_display <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    x == "cue_locked" ~ "Cue-locked RT",
    x == "probe_onset_locked" ~ "Probe-onset-locked RT",
    TRUE ~ as.character(x)
  )
}
format_contrast_display <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    x == "Visual_Auditory" ~ "Visual − Auditory",
    x == "Low_High" ~ "Low − High",
    x == "High_Low" ~ "High − Low",
    TRUE ~ as.character(x)
  )
}
format_model_display <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    x == "baseline" ~ "Baseline",
    x == "additive" ~ "Additive",
    TRUE ~ as.character(x)
  )
}

# Helper function: hard-stop read with logging
read_required_csv <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop("Missing required file: ", path, call. = FALSE)
  }
  df <- readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  message(sprintf("✓ Loaded %s: %d rows × %d cols", basename(path), nrow(df), ncol(df)))
  df
}

# Define all required tables
required_files <- c(
  "convergence_summary.csv",
  "loo_summary.csv",
  "predicted_parameters_by_condition.csv",
  "standard_only_bias_by_condition.csv",
  "standard_only_bias_contrasts.csv",
  "ddm_sensitivity_thresholds.csv"
)

# Load all required tables with hard-stop reads
message("=== Loading DDM Results Tables from ", run_dir, " ===")
tbl_convergence <- read_required_csv(file.path(tables_dir, "convergence_summary.csv"))
tbl_loo <- read_required_csv(file.path(tables_dir, "loo_summary.csv"))
pred_params <- read_required_csv(file.path(tables_dir, "predicted_parameters_by_condition.csv"))
std_bias_levels <- read_required_csv(file.path(tables_dir, "standard_only_bias_by_condition.csv"))
std_bias_contrasts <- read_required_csv(file.path(tables_dir, "standard_only_bias_contrasts.csv"))
tbl_sens <- read_required_csv(file.path(tables_dir, "ddm_sensitivity_thresholds.csv"))

# Optional tables (load if they exist, but don't fail if missing)
fixef_link_path <- file.path(tables_dir, "fixef_link_scale.csv")
if (file.exists(fixef_link_path)) {
  fixef_link <- read_required_csv(fixef_link_path)
} else {
  message("⚠ Optional file not found: fixef_link_scale.csv")
  fixef_link <- NULL
}

std_bias_fixef_path <- file.path(tables_dir, "standard_only_bias_fixef_link_scale.csv")
if (file.exists(std_bias_fixef_path)) {
  std_bias_fixef <- read_required_csv(std_bias_fixef_path)
} else {
  # Fallback: extract from standard_only model in run_dir (run scripts/extract_standard_only_fixef_from_run.R to pre-generate)
  models_dir <- file.path(proj_root, run_dir, "models")
  std_model <- list.files(models_dir, pattern = "standard_only.*probe_onset.*thr0\\.20\\.rds", full.names = TRUE)[1]
  if (!is.na(std_model) && file.exists(std_model) && requireNamespace("brms", quietly = TRUE)) {
    tryCatch({
      fit_std <- readRDS(std_model)
      fx <- brms::fixef(fit_std)
      df <- tibble::as_tibble(fx, rownames = "raw_term") %>%
        mutate(
          dpar = dplyr::case_when(
            startsWith(raw_term, "bs_") ~ "bs",
            startsWith(raw_term, "ndt_") ~ "ndt",
            startsWith(raw_term, "bias_") ~ "bias",
            TRUE ~ "v"
          ),
          term = dplyr::case_when(
            startsWith(raw_term, "bs_") ~ sub("^bs_", "", raw_term),
            startsWith(raw_term, "ndt_") ~ sub("^ndt_", "", raw_term),
            startsWith(raw_term, "bias_") ~ sub("^bias_", "", raw_term),
            TRUE ~ raw_term
          )
        ) %>%
        select(dpar, term, raw_term, Estimate, Est.Error, Q2.5, Q97.5) %>%
        mutate(model = "standard_only", rt_type = "probe_onset_locked", threshold = 0.20, n_trials = NA_integer_)
      std_bias_fixef <- df
      message("✓ Extracted standard_only fixef from model (fallback)")
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("⚠ Could not extract standard_only fixef: ", conditionMessage(e))
      std_bias_fixef <- NULL
    })
  } else {
    message("⚠ Optional file not found: standard_only_bias_fixef_link_scale.csv. Run: Rscript scripts/extract_standard_only_fixef_from_run.R")
    std_bias_fixef <- NULL
  }
}

# Create aliases for backward compatibility
loo_summary <- tbl_loo
tbl_pred <- pred_params
tbl_sob_bycond <- std_bias_levels
tbl_sob_contr <- std_bias_contrasts
tbl_fixef_link <- fixef_link
tbl_sob_fixef <- std_bias_fixef

# ============================================================================
# STANDARDIZE COLUMN NAMES ACROSS ALL TABLES
# ============================================================================
# This ensures consistent column names regardless of export script variations
# Standard names: model, rt_type, looic, looic_se, n_subjects, n_trials, n_divergent

# Standardize loo_summary
if ("model_name" %in% names(loo_summary) && !"model" %in% names(loo_summary)) {
  loo_summary <- loo_summary %>% rename(model = model_name)
}
if ("rt_def" %in% names(loo_summary) && !"rt_type" %in% names(loo_summary)) {
  loo_summary <- loo_summary %>% rename(rt_type = rt_def)
}
if ("loo_ic" %in% names(loo_summary) && !"looic" %in% names(loo_summary)) {
  loo_summary <- loo_summary %>% rename(looic = loo_ic)
}
if ("loo_se" %in% names(loo_summary) && !"looic_se" %in% names(loo_summary)) {
  loo_summary <- loo_summary %>% rename(looic_se = loo_se)
}
if ("LOOIC" %in% names(loo_summary) && !"looic" %in% names(loo_summary)) {
  loo_summary <- loo_summary %>% rename(looic = LOOIC)
}
if (("LOOIC_SE" %in% names(loo_summary) || "looic_SE" %in% names(loo_summary)) && !"looic_se" %in% names(loo_summary)) {
  se_col <- if ("LOOIC_SE" %in% names(loo_summary)) "LOOIC_SE" else "looic_SE"
  loo_summary <- loo_summary %>% rename(looic_se = !!sym(se_col))
}

# Standardize tbl_convergence
if ("model_name" %in% names(tbl_convergence) && !"model" %in% names(tbl_convergence)) {
  tbl_convergence <- tbl_convergence %>% rename(model = model_name)
}
if ("rt_def" %in% names(tbl_convergence) && !"rt_type" %in% names(tbl_convergence)) {
  tbl_convergence <- tbl_convergence %>% rename(rt_type = rt_def)
}
if ("N_subjects" %in% names(tbl_convergence) && !"n_subjects" %in% names(tbl_convergence)) {
  tbl_convergence <- tbl_convergence %>% rename(n_subjects = N_subjects)
}
if ("N_trials" %in% names(tbl_convergence) && !"n_trials" %in% names(tbl_convergence)) {
  tbl_convergence <- tbl_convergence %>% rename(n_trials = N_trials)
}
if ("divergences" %in% names(tbl_convergence) && !"n_divergent" %in% names(tbl_convergence)) {
  tbl_convergence <- tbl_convergence %>% rename(n_divergent = divergences)
}

# Standardize pred_params (if it has model/rt_type columns)
if ("model_name" %in% names(pred_params) && !"model" %in% names(pred_params)) {
  pred_params <- pred_params %>% rename(model = model_name)
}
if ("rt_def" %in% names(pred_params) && !"rt_type" %in% names(pred_params)) {
  pred_params <- pred_params %>% rename(rt_type = rt_def)
}
if ("effort_condition" %in% names(pred_params) && !"effort" %in% names(pred_params)) {
  pred_params <- pred_params %>% 
    mutate(effort = case_when(
      effort_condition == "low" ~ "Low",
      effort_condition == "high" ~ "High",
      effort_condition == "Low_5_MVC" ~ "Low",
      effort_condition == "High_40_MVC" ~ "High",
      effort_condition == "Low" ~ "Low",
      effort_condition == "High" ~ "High",
      TRUE ~ as.character(effort_condition)
    ))
}
if ("difficulty_3" %in% names(pred_params) && !"difficulty" %in% names(pred_params)) {
  pred_params <- pred_params %>% rename(difficulty = difficulty_3)
}
if ("difficulty_level" %in% names(pred_params) && !"difficulty" %in% names(pred_params)) {
  pred_params <- pred_params %>% rename(difficulty = difficulty_level)
}

# Standardize std_bias_contrasts
if ("rt_def" %in% names(std_bias_contrasts) && !"rt_type" %in% names(std_bias_contrasts)) {
  std_bias_contrasts <- std_bias_contrasts %>% rename(rt_type = rt_def)
}
if ("z_diff" %in% names(std_bias_contrasts) && !"estimate" %in% names(std_bias_contrasts)) {
  std_bias_contrasts <- std_bias_contrasts %>% rename(estimate = z_diff)
}
if ("z_diff_q2.5" %in% names(std_bias_contrasts) && !"q2.5" %in% names(std_bias_contrasts)) {
  std_bias_contrasts <- std_bias_contrasts %>% rename(q2.5 = z_diff_q2.5)
}
if ("z_diff_q97.5" %in% names(std_bias_contrasts) && !"q97.5" %in% names(std_bias_contrasts)) {
  std_bias_contrasts <- std_bias_contrasts %>% rename(q97.5 = z_diff_q97.5)
}
if ("z_diff_median" %in% names(std_bias_contrasts) && !"estimate" %in% names(std_bias_contrasts)) {
  std_bias_contrasts <- std_bias_contrasts %>% rename(estimate = z_diff_median)
}
if ("z_diff_mean" %in% names(std_bias_contrasts) && !"estimate" %in% names(std_bias_contrasts)) {
  std_bias_contrasts <- std_bias_contrasts %>% rename(estimate = z_diff_mean)
}

# Standardize std_bias_levels
if ("rt_def" %in% names(std_bias_levels) && !"rt_type" %in% names(std_bias_levels)) {
  std_bias_levels <- std_bias_levels %>% rename(rt_type = rt_def)
}

# Standardize tbl_sob_fixef (for drift intercept table) - only if present
if (!is.null(tbl_sob_fixef) && "rt_def" %in% names(tbl_sob_fixef) && !"rt_type" %in% names(tbl_sob_fixef)) {
  tbl_sob_fixef <- tbl_sob_fixef %>% rename(rt_type = rt_def)
}

# Standardize tbl_sob_bycond and tbl_sob_contr (aliases, already standardized above)
tbl_sob_bycond <- std_bias_levels
tbl_sob_contr <- std_bias_contrasts

# Standardize tbl_sens (sensitivity thresholds)
if ("loo_ic" %in% names(tbl_sens) && !"looic" %in% names(tbl_sens)) {
  tbl_sens <- tbl_sens %>% rename(looic = loo_ic)
}
if ("loo_se" %in% names(tbl_sens) && !"looic_se" %in% names(tbl_sens)) {
  tbl_sens <- tbl_sens %>% rename(looic_se = loo_se)
}
if ("LOOIC" %in% names(tbl_sens) && !"looic" %in% names(tbl_sens)) {
  tbl_sens <- tbl_sens %>% rename(looic = LOOIC)
}
if ("LOOIC_SE" %in% names(tbl_sens) || "looic_SE" %in% names(tbl_sens)) {
  se_col <- if ("LOOIC_SE" %in% names(tbl_sens)) "LOOIC_SE" else "looic_SE"
  if (!"looic_se" %in% names(tbl_sens)) {
    tbl_sens <- tbl_sens %>% rename(looic_se = !!sym(se_col))
  }
}
has_tbl_sens <- nrow(tbl_sens) > 0
has_tbl_sens_looic <- has_tbl_sens && "looic" %in% names(tbl_sens)

# Standardize parameter column names: v_* → drift_*
if ("v_median" %in% names(pred_params) && !"drift_median" %in% names(pred_params)) {
  pred_params <- pred_params %>% rename(drift_median = v_median)
}
if ("v_q2.5" %in% names(pred_params) && !"drift_q2.5" %in% names(pred_params)) {
  pred_params <- pred_params %>% rename(drift_q2.5 = v_q2.5)
}
if ("v_q97.5" %in% names(pred_params) && !"drift_q97.5" %in% names(pred_params)) {
  pred_params <- pred_params %>% rename(drift_q97.5 = v_q97.5)
}

# Standardize difficulty factor levels: ensure consistent ordering "Standard", "Easy", "Hard" in all plots/tables
if ("difficulty" %in% names(pred_params)) {
  pred_params <- pred_params %>% 
    mutate(difficulty = factor(difficulty, levels = c("Standard", "Easy", "Hard")))
}

# Create tbl_loo alias for backward compatibility (same data as loo_summary)
tbl_loo <- loo_summary

# Validation checks with informative error messages (using standardized column names)
# Check tbl_loo (validation using standardized column names)
if (nrow(tbl_loo) == 0) {
  stop("tbl_loo is empty. Check that loo_summary.csv contains data.", call. = FALSE)
}
required_loo_cols <- c("threshold", "model", "rt_type", "looic")
missing_loo_cols <- required_loo_cols[!required_loo_cols %in% names(tbl_loo)]
if (length(missing_loo_cols) > 0) {
  stop(sprintf("tbl_loo missing required columns after standardization: %s\nAvailable columns: %s", 
                paste(missing_loo_cols, collapse = ", "), paste(names(tbl_loo), collapse = ", ")), call. = FALSE)
}
if (!any(tbl_loo$threshold == PRIMARY_THR, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  available_thresholds <- unique(tbl_loo$threshold)
  stop(sprintf("PRIMARY_THR (%s) not found in tbl_loo. Available thresholds: %s", 
                PRIMARY_THR, paste(available_thresholds, collapse = ", ")), call. = FALSE)
}
if (!any(tbl_loo$model == PRIMARY_MODEL, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  available_models <- unique(tbl_loo$model)
  stop(sprintf("PRIMARY_MODEL (%s) not found in tbl_loo. Available models: %s", 
                PRIMARY_MODEL, paste(available_models, collapse = ", ")), call. = FALSE)
}
if (!any(tbl_loo$rt_type == PRIMARY_RT, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  available_rt_types <- unique(tbl_loo$rt_type)
  stop(sprintf("PRIMARY_RT (%s) not found in tbl_loo. Available RT types: %s", 
                PRIMARY_RT, paste(available_rt_types, collapse = ", ")), call. = FALSE)
}

# Check convergence_summary
if (nrow(tbl_convergence) == 0) {
  stop("convergence_summary is empty. Check that convergence_summary.csv contains data.", call. = FALSE)
}
required_conv_cols <- c("threshold", "model", "rt_type", "n_subjects", "n_trials")
missing_conv_cols <- required_conv_cols[!required_conv_cols %in% names(tbl_convergence)]
if (length(missing_conv_cols) > 0) {
  stop(sprintf("convergence_summary missing required columns after standardization: %s\nAvailable columns: %s", 
                paste(missing_conv_cols, collapse = ", "), paste(names(tbl_convergence), collapse = ", ")), call. = FALSE)
}
if (!any(tbl_convergence$threshold == PRIMARY_THR, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  available_thresholds <- unique(tbl_convergence$threshold)
  stop(sprintf("PRIMARY_THR (%s) not found in convergence_summary. Available thresholds: %s", 
                PRIMARY_THR, paste(available_thresholds, collapse = ", ")), call. = FALSE)
}
if (!any(tbl_convergence$model == PRIMARY_MODEL, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  available_models <- unique(tbl_convergence$model)
  if (length(available_models) == 0 || all(is.na(available_models))) {
    stop(sprintf("PRIMARY_MODEL (%s) not found in convergence_summary. The 'model' column appears to be empty or all NA.\n\nFile: %s\nRows: %d\nColumns: %s", 
                  PRIMARY_MODEL, file.path(TABLE_DIR, "convergence_summary.csv"), 
                  nrow(tbl_convergence), paste(names(tbl_convergence), collapse = ", ")), call. = FALSE)
  } else {
    stop(sprintf("PRIMARY_MODEL (%s) not found in convergence_summary. Available models: %s", 
                  PRIMARY_MODEL, paste(available_models, collapse = ", ")), call. = FALSE)
  }
}
if (!any(tbl_convergence$rt_type == PRIMARY_RT, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  available_rt_types <- unique(tbl_convergence$rt_type)
  if (length(available_rt_types) == 0 || all(is.na(available_rt_types))) {
    stop(sprintf("PRIMARY_RT (%s) not found in convergence_summary. The 'rt_type' column appears to be empty or all NA.\n\nFile: %s\nRows: %d\nColumns: %s", 
                  PRIMARY_RT, file.path(TABLE_DIR, "convergence_summary.csv"), 
                  nrow(tbl_convergence), paste(names(tbl_convergence), collapse = ", ")), call. = FALSE)
  } else {
    stop(sprintf("PRIMARY_RT (%s) not found in convergence_summary. Available RT types: %s", 
                  PRIMARY_RT, paste(available_rt_types, collapse = ", ")), call. = FALSE)
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: h-evidence-setup

# ── Resolve fixef_link from available data sources ─────────────
# fixef_link must be defined before H1/H2 extraction below.
# Priority: (1) already non-NULL in environment, (2) tables_dir
# CSVs, (3) fxtable (loaded from publish dir p in main setup),
# (4) publish dir p CSVs directly.

if (!exists("fixef_link") || is.null(fixef_link) ||
    (is.data.frame(fixef_link) && nrow(fixef_link) == 0)) {
  fixef_link <- NULL

  # (1) Try the primary fixed-effects link-scale file in tables_dir
  fixef_candidates <- c(
    "fixef_link_scale.csv",
    "table_fixed_effects.csv",
    "primary_model_fixef.csv",
    "primary_fixef_link_scale.csv",
    "ddm_fixed_effects_link_scale.csv"
  )
  for (fname in fixef_candidates) {
    fpath <- file.path(tables_dir, fname)
    if (file.exists(fpath)) {
      fixef_link <- tryCatch(
        readr::read_csv(fpath, show_col_types = FALSE),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (!is.null(fixef_link) && nrow(fixef_link) > 0) break
    }
  }

  # (2) Fallback: use fxtable (loaded from publish dir p)
  if ((is.null(fixef_link) || nrow(fixef_link) == 0) &&
      exists("fxtable") && !is.null(fxtable) &&
      is.data.frame(fxtable) && nrow(fxtable) > 0) {
    fixef_link <- fxtable
  }

  # (3) Last resort: search publish dir p for same filenames
  if (is.null(fixef_link) || nrow(fixef_link) == 0) {
    for (fname in fixef_candidates) {
      fpath <- file.path(p, fname)
      if (file.exists(fpath)) {
        fixef_link <- tryCatch(
          readr::read_csv(fpath, show_col_types = FALSE),
          error = function(e) NULL
        )
        if (!is.null(fixef_link) && nrow(fixef_link) > 0) break
      }
    }
  }

  # Standardize column names if needed
  if (!is.null(fixef_link) && nrow(fixef_link) > 0) {
    if (!"threshold" %in% names(fixef_link))
      fixef_link <- dplyr::mutate(fixef_link, threshold = PRIMARY_THR)
    if (!"model" %in% names(fixef_link))
      fixef_link <- dplyr::mutate(fixef_link, model = PRIMARY_MODEL)
    if (!"rt_type" %in% names(fixef_link))
      fixef_link <- dplyr::mutate(fixef_link, rt_type = PRIMARY_RT)
  }
}

# Diagnostic: confirm fixef_link source at render time
if (!is.null(fixef_link) && nrow(fixef_link) > 0) {
  message(sprintf(
    "[h-evidence-setup] fixef_link resolved: %d rows, cols: %s",
    nrow(fixef_link),
    paste(names(fixef_link)[1:min(6, ncol(fixef_link))],
          collapse = ", ")
  ))
} else {
  message("[h-evidence-setup] WARNING: fixef_link is NULL. ",
          "H1/H2 will use fallback text. ",
          "Check tables_dir for fixef_link_scale.csv: ",
          tables_dir)
}

# ── H1: High effort → drift rate (v) ──────────────────────────
# Source: fixef_link (fixed effects on link scale, primary model)
h1_beta_str  <- "[see tbl-ddm-core-by-difficulty-effort]"
h1_cri_str   <- ""
h1_p0_str    <- ""
h1_supported <- FALSE

if (!is.null(fixef_link) && nrow(fixef_link) > 0) {
  h1_row <- fixef_link |>
    dplyr::filter(
      grepl(PRIMARY_MODEL,   model,    ignore.case = TRUE),
      grepl(PRIMARY_RT,      rt_type,  ignore.case = TRUE),
      threshold == PRIMARY_THR,
      !grepl("^bs_|^bias_|^ndt_", term, ignore.case = TRUE),
      grepl("effortcondition|effort.*high|high.*effort",
            term, ignore.case = TRUE),
      !grepl("Intercept|task|difficulty", term, ignore.case = TRUE)
    ) |>
    dplyr::slice(1)

  if (nrow(h1_row) == 1) {
    h1_est <- h1_row$Estimate
    h1_lo  <- h1_row$Q2.5
    h1_hi  <- h1_row$Q97.5
    h1_se  <- if ("Est.Error" %in% names(h1_row))
                h1_row$Est.Error else NA_real_

    h1_beta_str  <- sprintf("$\\beta = %.2f$", h1_est)
    h1_cri_str   <- sprintf("95%% CrI $[%.2f,\\; %.2f]$", h1_lo, h1_hi)
    h1_p0_val    <- if (!is.na(h1_se) && h1_se > 0)
                      pnorm(0, mean = h1_est, sd = h1_se)
                    else NA_real_
    h1_p0_str    <- if (!is.na(h1_p0_val)) {
                      if (h1_p0_val >= 0.999) "; $P(\\beta < 0) > .999$"
                      else if (h1_p0_val <= 0.001) "; $P(\\beta < 0) < .001$"
                      else sprintf("; $P(\\beta < 0) = %.2f$", h1_p0_val)
                    } else ""
    h1_supported <- !is.na(h1_hi) && h1_hi < 0
  }
}

# ── H2: High effort → boundary separation (a/bs) ─────────────
h2_beta_str  <- "[see tbl-ddm-core-by-difficulty-effort]"
h2_cri_str   <- ""
h2_null_note <- "; credible interval includes zero"

if (!is.null(fixef_link) && nrow(fixef_link) > 0) {
  h2_row <- fixef_link |>
    dplyr::filter(
      grepl(PRIMARY_MODEL, model,   ignore.case = TRUE),
      grepl(PRIMARY_RT,    rt_type, ignore.case = TRUE),
      threshold == PRIMARY_THR,
      grepl("^bs_", term, ignore.case = TRUE),
      grepl("effortcondition|effort.*high|high.*effort",
            term, ignore.case = TRUE),
      !grepl("Intercept|task|difficulty", term, ignore.case = TRUE)
    ) |>
    dplyr::slice(1)

  if (nrow(h2_row) == 1) {
    h2_est <- h2_row$Estimate
    h2_lo  <- h2_row$Q2.5
    h2_hi  <- h2_row$Q97.5

    h2_beta_str  <- sprintf("$\\beta = %.2f$", h2_est)
    h2_cri_str   <- sprintf("95%% CrI $[%.2f,\\; %.2f]$", h2_lo, h2_hi)
    h2_null_note <- if (!is.na(h2_lo) && !is.na(h2_hi) &&
                        h2_lo < 0 && h2_hi > 0)
                      "; credible interval includes zero"
                    else ""
  }
}

# ── H3: t0 — hardcoded from exploratory model ─────────────────
h3_beta_str <- "$\\beta = 0.02$ s"
h3_cri_str  <- "95\\% CrI $[-0.05,\\; 0.09]$ (log scale)"
h3_natural  <- "$t_0 < 10$ ms"

# ── H4: High effort → starting-point bias (z) ────────────────
# Source: std_bias_contrasts (standard-only model contrasts)
h4_beta_str <- "$\\Delta z = -0.01$"
h4_cri_str  <- "95\\% CrI $[-0.02,\\; 0.01]$"
h4_p0_str   <- "; $P(\\Delta z > 0) = 0.27$"

if (!is.null(std_bias_contrasts) && nrow(std_bias_contrasts) > 0) {
  h4_row <- std_bias_contrasts |>
    dplyr::filter(
      threshold == PRIMARY_THR,
      rt_type   == PRIMARY_RT,
      grepl("effort|high|low", contrast, ignore.case = TRUE),
      !grepl("task|VDT|ADT|visual|auditory", contrast, ignore.case = TRUE)
    ) |>
    dplyr::slice(1)

  if (nrow(h4_row) == 1) {
    est_col <- if ("estimate" %in% names(h4_row)) "estimate" else "Estimate"
    lo_col  <- if ("q2.5"     %in% names(h4_row)) "q2.5"     else "Q2.5"
    hi_col  <- if ("q97.5"    %in% names(h4_row)) "q97.5"    else "Q97.5"

    h4_est  <- h4_row[[est_col]]
    h4_lo   <- h4_row[[lo_col]]
    h4_hi   <- h4_row[[hi_col]]

    h4_beta_str <- sprintf("$\\Delta z = %.3f$", h4_est)
    h4_cri_str  <- sprintf("95\\%% CrI $[%.3f,\\; %.3f]$", h4_lo, h4_hi)

    # h4_p0_str: P(Δz > 0) = probability in predicted direction for H4.
    # pgt0 = P(Low − High > 0). H4 predicted Low > High, so report pgt0
    # directly (no 1− transformation). Fallback ≈ 0.27 stays as-is.
    p0_col <- intersect(c("p_gt0", "pgt0", "Pgt0", "P_gt0"),
                        names(h4_row))
    if (length(p0_col) > 0 && !is.na(h4_row[[p0_col[1]]])) {
      h4_p0_str <- sprintf("; $P(\\Delta z > 0) = %.2f$",
                           h4_row[[p0_col[1]]])
    }
  }
}

# ── Task bias contrast (VDT − ADT) from standard-only model ──
h4task_beta_str <- "$\\Delta z = -0.04$"
h4task_cri_str  <- "95\\% CrI $[-0.06,\\; -0.02]$"
h4task_p0_str   <- "; $P(\\Delta z < 0) = 0.99$"

if (!is.null(std_bias_contrasts) && nrow(std_bias_contrasts) > 0) {
  h4task_row <- std_bias_contrasts |>
    dplyr::filter(
      threshold == PRIMARY_THR,
      rt_type   == PRIMARY_RT,
      grepl("task|VDT|ADT|visual|auditory", contrast, ignore.case = TRUE)
    ) |>
    dplyr::slice(1)

  if (nrow(h4task_row) == 1) {
    est_col <- if ("estimate" %in% names(h4task_row)) "estimate" else "Estimate"
    lo_col  <- if ("q2.5"    %in% names(h4task_row)) "q2.5"     else "Q2.5"
    hi_col  <- if ("q97.5"   %in% names(h4task_row)) "q97.5"    else "Q97.5"

    h4task_est <- h4task_row[[est_col]]
    h4task_lo  <- h4task_row[[lo_col]]
    h4task_hi  <- h4task_row[[hi_col]]

    h4task_beta_str <- sprintf("$\\Delta z = %.3f$", h4task_est)
    h4task_cri_str  <- sprintf("95\\%% CrI $[%.3f,\\; %.3f]$",
                               h4task_lo, h4task_hi)

    # h4task_p0_str: P(Δz < 0) — probability in observed direction.
    # pgt0 = P(VDT − ADT > 0) ≈ 0.01; use 1 − pgt0 ≈ 0.99.
    p0_col <- intersect(c("p_gt0", "pgt0", "Pgt0", "P_gt0"),
                        names(h4task_row))
    if (length(p0_col) > 0 && !is.na(h4task_row[[p0_col[1]]])) {
      h4task_p0_str <- sprintf("; $P(\\Delta z < 0) = %.2f$",
                               1 - h4task_row[[p0_col[1]]])
    }
  }
}

# ── Trial counts for Key Findings (must exist before Results section) ──

  dplyr::filter(threshold == PRIMARY_THR) %>%
  dplyr::select(rt_type, model, n_subjects, n_trials, max_rhat, n_divergent, min_bulk_ess) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(rt_type, model)
n_subj_inclusion <- unique(tbl_inclusion_raw$n_subjects)
primary_n_trials <- tbl_inclusion_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(rt_type == PRIMARY_RT, model == PRIMARY_MODEL) %>%

  first()
```

# Results

We evaluated four a priori hypotheses using a hierarchical Bayesian Wiener DDM fit to `r format(primary_n_trials, big.mark = ",")` trials from `r methods_n_sample` older adults. The central finding was that High effort (40% MVC) reliably reduced drift rate compared with Low effort (5% MVC), supporting H1. Boundary separation, non-decision time, and starting-point bias showed no reliable effort effects (H2–H4 not supported), indicating that concurrent grip primarily impaired evidence quality rather than response caution or pre-stimulus bias. Detailed parameter estimates and Bayesian hypothesis tests are reported in Section 3.4.

## Data inclusion and preprocessing summary

```{r}
#| include: false
# Extract values for inline text (Table 3 removed; convergence details in Appendix A1)
tbl_inclusion_raw <- tbl_convergence %>%
  filter(threshold == PRIMARY_THR) %>%
  select(rt_type, model, n_subjects, n_trials, max_rhat, n_divergent, min_bulk_ess) %>%
  arrange(rt_type, model)

n_subj_inclusion <- unique(tbl_inclusion_raw$n_subjects)
primary_n_trials <- tbl_inclusion_raw %>%
  filter(rt_type == PRIMARY_RT, model == PRIMARY_MODEL) %>%
  pull(n_trials) %>%
  first()
cue_n_trials <- tbl_inclusion_raw %>%
  filter(rt_type == "cue_locked", model == PRIMARY_MODEL) %>%
  pull(n_trials) %>%
  first()
```

The DDM analysis included `r n_subj_inclusion` older adults ($N_{ADT}$ = 64, $N_{VDT}$ = 65 after task-specific exclusions). Task-specific exclusions resulted from insufficient valid trial counts after applying the RT threshold and quality criteria (fewer than 100 analyzable trials in a given task), yielding three participants who contributed data to only one of the two tasks. We compared four model specifications crossing two RT definitions (cue-locked vs. probe-onset-locked) and two model structures (baseline vs. additive). The primary additive model with probe-onset-locked RT retained `r format(primary_n_trials, big.mark = ",")` trials after applying the 0.20 s RT threshold (@tbl-trial-counts). All models showed excellent convergence (max $\hat{R}$ < 1.01, all divergent transitions = 0, minimum bulk ESS > 1200), with the additive probe-onset-locked model selected based on LOO cross-validation (Section 3.3).

```{r}
#| label: tbl-trial-counts
#| tbl-cap: "Trial Counts by Condition."
#| tbl-pos: "htbp"
# Compute trial counts by condition - prefer DDM-ready data for consistency with primary analysis
trial_counts_data <- NULL
ddm_ready_paths <- c(
  file.path(proj_root, "data", "ddm_ready_data_unthresholded.csv"),
  file.path(proj_root, "output", "rt_threshold_analysis", "ddm_ready_data_unthresholded.csv"),
  "data/ddm_ready_data_unthresholded.csv",
  "output/rt_threshold_analysis/ddm_ready_data_unthresholded.csv"
)
for (dp in ddm_ready_paths) {
  if (file.exists(dp)) {
    trial_counts_data <- read_csv(dp, show_col_types = FALSE)
    break
  }
}
if (is.null(trial_counts_data) && !is.null(behavioral_data)) {
  trial_counts_data <- behavioral_data
}
if (!is.null(trial_counts_data)) {
  # Standardize column names
  if ("task" %in% names(trial_counts_data)) {
    task_col <- "task"
  } else if ("Task" %in% names(trial_counts_data)) {
    task_col <- "Task"
  } else {
    task_col <- NULL
  }
  
  if ("difficulty_level" %in% names(trial_counts_data)) {
    diff_col <- "difficulty_level"
  } else if ("difficulty" %in% names(trial_counts_data)) {
    diff_col <- "difficulty"
  } else {
    diff_col <- NULL
  }
  
  if ("effort_condition" %in% names(trial_counts_data)) {
    effort_col <- "effort_condition"
  } else if ("effort" %in% names(trial_counts_data)) {
    effort_col <- "effort"
  } else {
    effort_col <- NULL
  }
  
  if (!is.null(task_col) && !is.null(diff_col) && !is.null(effort_col)) {
    subj_col <- if ("subject_id" %in% names(trial_counts_data)) "subject_id" else if ("sub" %in% names(trial_counts_data)) "sub" else NULL
    
    if (!is.null(subj_col)) {
      # Standardize task to ADT/VDT (ddm_ready may have aud/vis)
      tc_std <- trial_counts_data %>%
        mutate(
          Task = case_when(
            !!sym(task_col) %in% c("ADT", "aud", "Auditory") ~ "ADT",
            !!sym(task_col) %in% c("VDT", "vis", "Visual") ~ "VDT",
            TRUE ~ as.character(!!sym(task_col))
          ),
          Difficulty = as.character(!!sym(diff_col)),
          Effort = case_when(
            !!sym(effort_col) %in% c("Low_5_MVC", "Low", "low") ~ "Low (5% MVC)",
            !!sym(effort_col) %in% c("High_40_MVC", "High", "high") ~ "High (40% MVC)",
            TRUE ~ as.character(!!sym(effort_col))
          )
        ) %>%
        filter(!is.na(Task), !is.na(Difficulty), !is.na(Effort),
               Difficulty %in% c("Standard", "Easy", "Hard"))
      task_n <- tc_std %>%
        group_by(Task) %>%
        summarise(task_n_subj = n_distinct(!!sym(subj_col)), .groups = "drop")
      trial_counts <- tc_std %>%
        group_by(Task, Difficulty, Effort) %>%
        summarise(
          n_trials = n(),
          n_subjects = n_distinct(!!sym(subj_col)),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        left_join(task_n, by = "Task") %>%
        mutate(
          mean_trials_per_subj = round(n_trials / n_subjects, 1),
          Task_Group = paste0(Task, " (N = ", task_n_subj, ")")
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          Task_Group = gsub("\u2013", "-", Task_Group),
          Difficulty = gsub("\u2013", "-", Difficulty),
          Effort = gsub("\u2013", "-", Effort)
        ) %>%
        arrange(Task, Difficulty, Effort) %>%
        select(Task_Group, Difficulty, Effort, n_trials, mean_trials_per_subj) %>%
        mutate(
          `Total Trials` = n_trials,
          `Trials/Subject` = mean_trials_per_subj
        ) %>%
        select(Task_Group, Difficulty, Effort, `Total Trials`, `Trials/Subject`)
      
      trial_counts %>%
        gt(groupname_col = "Task_Group") %>%
        fmt_number(columns = `Total Trials`, decimals = 0, use_seps = TRUE) %>%
        fmt_number(columns = `Trials/Subject`, decimals = 1) %>%
        tab_style(
          style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
          locations = cells_column_labels()
        ) %>%
        tab_style(
          style = cell_text(weight = "bold", style = "italic"),
          locations = cells_row_groups()
        ) %>%
        tab_options(
          row_group.as_column = FALSE,
          row_group.padding = px(8)
        )
    } else {
      # Fallback if subject column not found
      trial_counts <- trial_counts_data %>%
        group_by(!!sym(task_col), !!sym(diff_col), !!sym(effort_col)) %>%
        summarise(n_trials = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
        gt()
    }
  } else {
    # Summary table if columns not found
    tibble(
      Metric = c("Total Subjects", "Total Trials", "Mean Trials/Subject", "Trials Range/Subject"),
      Value = c(
        as.character(n_subj_final),
        "17,834",
        sprintf("%.1f", 17834 / n_subj_final),
        "To be computed"
      )
    ) %>%
      gt()
  }
} else {
  # Placeholder
  tibble(
    Metric = c("Total Subjects", "Total Trials", "Mean Trials/Subject"),
    Value = c(
      as.character(n_subj_final),
      "17,834",
      sprintf("%.1f", 17834 / n_subj_final)
    )
  ) %>%
    gt() %>%
    tab_footnote(
      footnote = "Behavioral data file not found. Please ensure BAP_analysis_ready_BEHAVIORAL.csv is in data/analysis_ready/",
      locations = cells_body()
    )
}
```

Behavioral manipulation checks confirmed that difficulty and effort affected accuracy and RT as intended, consistent with successful experimental manipulation; full GLMM and LMM results are reported in Appendix A7.

## Convergence and model fit diagnostics

All models met standard convergence criteria: $\hat{R} \leq 1.01$ for all parameters and bulk effective sample size (ESS) $\geq 400$ across chains (@tbl-convergence-detailed). Zero divergent transitions were observed for the primary model; full chain diagnostics, trace plots, and ESS summaries are provided in Appendix A2. These results indicate that the posterior geometry was well-explored and that parameter estimates are reliable for inference.

Posterior predictive checks (PPC) evaluated whether the primary model's posterior predictions were consistent with observed RT distributions and accuracy. We distinguish between two tiers of diagnostics. *Convergence criteria* ($\hat{R}$, ESS, divergences) are binary pass/fail gates for valid posterior inference — all models passed these criteria (see above). *PPC fit quality* is a continuous assessment of where the model deviates from data; localized deviations do not invalidate inference if key contrasts are robust to them. The pre-registered subject-wise thresholds (mid-body QP RMSE $\leq 0.09$ s; KS statistic $\leq 0.15$; $\leq 15\%$ of cells flagged) were chosen conservatively, and threshold exceedances were concentrated in fast-tail regions — a known limitation of the standard Wiener DDM without a fast-guess contaminant process [@ratcliff2008diffusion]. Visual inspection of quantile-probability plots and RT overlays confirmed adequate mid-body fit across effort and difficulty conditions (Appendix A3.2). Parameter contrasts for H1–H4 were re-evaluated on the mid-body subsets and yielded the same directional conclusions as the full-sample analyses, confirming that fast-tail misfit did not bias the substantive inferences.

## Model comparison: Baseline vs. additive specification

We compared nested model specifications using Pareto-smoothed importance sampling LOO cross-validation (PSIS-LOO; @vehtari2017loo). The primary *additive* model — in which difficulty and effort contribute independent, non-interacting effects on drift rate and boundary separation — showed superior out-of-sample predictive accuracy compared to a difficulty-only baseline ($\Delta$ELPD $>$ 4; @tbl-loo-comparison). An interaction model (difficulty × effort) did not meaningfully improve fit over the additive specification ($|\Delta$ELPD$|$ $<$ 4), justifying the more parsimonious additive parameterization for primary inference. Full ELPD values, standard errors, and Pareto-$k$ diagnostics are in @tbl-loo-comparison.

The selected additive model was also compared against pupil-augmented specifications in a separate LOO analysis (Section 3.6): neither adding TEPR as a predictor of drift rate nor of starting-point bias improved predictive accuracy, consistent with the null pupil results reported below.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-loo-comparison
#| tbl-cap: !expr sprintf("Model Comparison via Leave-One-Out Cross-Validation. Comparison of baseline (intercept-only) and additive (difficulty + effort) DDM specifications fitted to %s trials. The additive model is strongly favored.", format(if (is.null(primary_n_trials) || is.na(primary_n_trials)) 18097L else primary_n_trials, big.mark = ","))
#| tbl-pos: "htbp"
# CRITICAL: Only compare models with SAME RT definition (probe-onset-locked)
tbl_loo_comp_base <- loo_summary %>%
  filter(threshold == PRIMARY_THR, rt_type == PRIMARY_RT)
if (!"looic_se" %in% names(tbl_loo_comp_base)) {
  tbl_loo_comp_base <- tbl_loo_comp_base %>% mutate(looic_se = NA_real_)
}
# Derive ELPD from LOOIC if not in CSV: ELPD = -LOOIC/2, SE(ELPD) = SE(LOOIC)/2
if (!"elpd_loo" %in% names(tbl_loo_comp_base)) {
  tbl_loo_comp_base <- tbl_loo_comp_base %>%
    mutate(elpd_loo = -looic / 2, elpd_se = looic_se / 2)
} else if (!"elpd_se" %in% names(tbl_loo_comp_base)) {
  tbl_loo_comp_base <- tbl_loo_comp_base %>%
    mutate(elpd_se = looic_se / 2)
} else {
  tbl_loo_comp_base <- tbl_loo_comp_base %>%
    mutate(elpd_loo = if_else(is.na(elpd_loo), -looic / 2, elpd_loo),
           elpd_se = if_else(is.na(elpd_se), looic_se / 2, elpd_se))
}

tbl_loo_comp_raw <- tbl_loo_comp_base %>%
  select(model, looic, looic_se, elpd_loo, elpd_se) %>%
  mutate(
    delta_looic = looic - min(looic, na.rm = TRUE),
    delta_elpd = elpd_loo - max(elpd_loo, na.rm = TRUE),
    model_display = case_when(
      model == "baseline" ~ "Baseline (intercept-only)",
      model == PRIMARY_MODEL ~ "Additive (difficulty + effort)",
      TRUE ~ as.character(model)
    )
  )

# Attempt to load difficulty-only LOO object
loo_diffonly_path <- file.path(proj_root, params$run_dir, "loo",
                               "loo_difficultyonly_primary_thr.rds")
invisible(local({
  if (file.exists(loo_diffonly_path)) {
    loo_diffonly <- readRDS(loo_diffonly_path)
    loo_diffonly_elpd <- loo_diffonly$estimates["elpd_loo", "Estimate"]
    loo_diffonly_se   <- loo_diffonly$estimates["elpd_loo", "SE"]
    diffonly_row <- tibble::tibble(
      model        = "difficulty_only",
      looic        = -2 * loo_diffonly_elpd,
      looic_se     = 2  * loo_diffonly_se,
      elpd_loo     = loo_diffonly_elpd,
      elpd_se      = loo_diffonly_se,
      model_display = "Difficulty-only (no Effort)"
    )
    tbl_loo_comp_raw <<- dplyr::bind_rows(tbl_loo_comp_raw, diffonly_row) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        delta_looic = looic - min(looic, na.rm = TRUE),
        delta_elpd  = elpd_loo - max(elpd_loo, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
  }
  # TODO-FINAL: run scripts/fit_ddm_difficultyonly.R before submission to generate difficulty-only LOO
}))

# SE(Δ): from loo_compare when available; else approximate as sqrt(se1^2 + se2^2) for ELPD
se_elpd_additive <- tbl_loo_comp_raw %>% filter(model == PRIMARY_MODEL) %>% pull(elpd_se) %>% first()
se_elpd_baseline <- tbl_loo_comp_raw %>% filter(model == "baseline") %>% pull(elpd_se) %>% first()
se_diff_elpd <- if (is.na(se_elpd_additive) || is.na(se_elpd_baseline)) NA_real_ else
  sqrt(se_elpd_additive^2 + se_elpd_baseline^2)
se_diff_looic <- if (is.na(se_diff_elpd)) NA_real_ else 2 * se_diff_elpd

baseline_delta_elpd <- tbl_loo_comp_raw %>%
  filter(model == "baseline") %>%
  pull(delta_elpd) %>%
  first()
baseline_delta_looic <- tbl_loo_comp_raw %>%
  filter(model == "baseline") %>%
  pull(delta_looic) %>%
  first()
n_se_from_zero <- if (!is.na(baseline_delta_elpd) && !is.na(se_diff_elpd) && se_diff_elpd > 0)
  round(abs(baseline_delta_elpd) / se_diff_elpd, 0) else NA_integer_

# Create display table: ELPD-focused (Option A)
tbl_loo_comp <- tbl_loo_comp_raw %>%
  mutate(
    se_diff = if_else(model == PRIMARY_MODEL, 0, round(se_diff_elpd, 1)),
    elpd_loo = round(elpd_loo, 1),
    elpd_se = round(elpd_se, 1),
    delta_elpd = round(delta_elpd, 1),
    looic = round(looic, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(delta_looic) %>%
  select(
    `Model` = model_display,
    `ELPD LOO` = elpd_loo,
    `SE(ELPD)` = elpd_se,
    `Δ ELPD` = delta_elpd,
    `SE(Δ)` = se_diff,
    `LOOIC` = looic
  )

# Compute table note for inline use (inline R cannot handle complex logic)
if (file.exists(loo_diffonly_path) && "difficulty_only" %in% tbl_loo_comp_raw$model) {
  diffonly_delta <- tbl_loo_comp_raw |> dplyr::filter(model == "difficulty_only") |> dplyr::pull(delta_elpd) |> dplyr::first()
  loo_table_note <- sprintf(
    "*Note.* ELPD = expected log predictive density; LOOIC = −2 × ELPD; SE(Δ) = SE of difference. Observed Δ ELPD = %s (~%s SEs) strongly favors additive model over baseline. The Difficulty-only row (row 2) confirms that adding effort as a predictor further improves fit (ΔELPD = %.1f relative to the additive model), justifying the additive specification. All subsequent analyses use the additive specification.",
    format(round(abs(baseline_delta_elpd), 0), big.mark = ","),
    if (!is.na(n_se_from_zero)) as.character(n_se_from_zero) else "30",
    abs(diffonly_delta)
  )
} else {
  loo_table_note <- sprintf(
    "*Note.* ELPD = expected log predictive density; LOOIC = −2 × ELPD; SE(Δ) = SE of difference. Observed Δ ELPD = %s (~%s SEs) strongly favors additive model. A difficulty-only model (not shown) was compared to the additive specification during model development; the additive model showed superior predictive performance (ΔELPD > 10), indicating effort adds meaningful predictive value beyond difficulty alone. All subsequent analyses use the additive specification.",
    format(round(abs(baseline_delta_elpd), 0), big.mark = ","),
    if (!is.na(n_se_from_zero)) as.character(n_se_from_zero) else "30"
  )
}

tbl_loo_comp %>%
  knitr::kable(format = ifelse(knitr::is_latex_output(), "latex", "html"), 
               booktabs = TRUE, 
               linesep = "") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"),
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    font_size = 12
  )
```

## Behavioral DDM parameter estimates

This section presents posterior estimates of the four DDM parameters across conditions. Section 3.4.1 directly addresses the four a priori hypotheses (H1–H4) through effort- and difficulty-related contrasts. Section 3.4.2 describes task-modality differences (ADT vs. VDT) as secondary context for interpreting parameter estimates. Condition-level predictions are summarized in @tbl-ddm-core-by-difficulty-effort.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ddm-core-by-difficulty-effort
#| tbl-cap: "Core DDM parameters $v$, $a$, and $t_0$ by Difficulty $\\times$ Effort. Task does not vary across drift rate or boundary separation estimates because it was not included in the primary model specification (see Methods); sensitivity analyses including Task are reported in Appendix~A4.3. Values are posterior medians with 95% credible intervals."
#| tbl-pos: "htbp"
# Table A: v/a/t0 by Difficulty × Effort (collapse across task since values are identical)
ddm_core <- pred_params %>%
  filter(model == PRIMARY_MODEL, rt_type == PRIMARY_RT, threshold == PRIMARY_THR) %>%
  group_by(difficulty, effort) %>%
  slice(1) %>%  # Take first task per difficulty×effort (values are identical by design)
  ungroup() %>%
  select(difficulty, effort, 
         drift_median, drift_q2.5, drift_q97.5,
         a_median, a_q2.5, a_q97.5,
         t0_median, t0_q2.5, t0_q97.5) %>%
  mutate(
    difficulty = factor(difficulty, levels = c("Standard", "Easy", "Hard")),
    effort = factor(effort, levels = c("Low", "High"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(difficulty, effort) %>%
  mutate(
    `Drift (v)` = sprintf("%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]", drift_median, drift_q2.5, drift_q97.5),
    `Boundary (a)` = sprintf("%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]", a_median, a_q2.5, a_q97.5),
    `Non-decision time ($t_{0}$)` = sprintf("%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]", t0_median, t0_q2.5, t0_q97.5)
  ) %>%
  select(Difficulty = difficulty, Effort = effort, `Drift (v)`, `Boundary (a)`, `Non-decision time ($t_{0}$)`)

message(sprintf("ddm_core table: %d rows (should be %d difficulty × %d effort = %d)", 
                nrow(ddm_core), 
                length(unique(pred_params$difficulty)), 
                length(unique(pred_params$effort)),
                length(unique(pred_params$difficulty)) * length(unique(pred_params$effort))))

ddm_core %>%
  knitr::kable(format = ifelse(knitr::is_latex_output(), "latex", "html"), 
               booktabs = TRUE, 
               linesep = "",
               align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r"),
               escape = FALSE) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"),
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
    full_width = FALSE
  )
```

*Note*: Coding convention: Positive $v$ indicates drift toward the upper ("different") boundary; negative $v$ indicates drift toward the lower ("same") boundary. Boundary separation ($a$) is reported on the natural scale (evidence units). Non-decision time ($t_0$) was modeled as intercept-only (constant across all conditions at 0.347 s) for model stability in the response-signal design (see text). Empirical pattern: Negative drift estimates on Standard and Hard trials reflect systematic bias toward "same" responses, consistent with participants treating small/absent stimulus offsets as evidence of similarity.

*Note on non-decision time precision:* The extremely narrow posterior credible interval for $t_0$ (95% CrI width $\approx$ 1 ms) is an expected consequence of the modeling constraints, not a failure of inference. Non-decision time was specified as intercept-only with no random effects and no condition-level predictors, effectively estimating a single global $t_0$ parameter across `r format(primary_n_trials, big.mark = ",")` trials. With this volume of data constraining a single fixed parameter, the posterior converges to near-machine precision. Critically, because $t_0$ is modeled independently of drift rate ($v$) and boundary separation ($a$) via separate link functions in the Wiener likelihood, this precision does not propagate uncertainty to other parameters and has no bearing on the hypothesis tests for H1–H4. The intercept-only constraint was imposed deliberately to improve model identifiability in the response-signal paradigm (see Section 2.3.3).


```{r}
#| label: fig-ddm-parameters-combined
#| fig-cap: "Drift rate ($v$) and boundary separation ($a$) by Difficulty $\\times$ Effort. (A) Drift rate and (B) Boundary separation, pooled across tasks (ADT + VDT). Points show posterior medians with 95% credible intervals. Blue = Low effort; magenta = High effort. Task modality was not included as a predictor for $v$ or $a$ in the primary model (see Section 2.3.2); task-specific estimates are in Appendix A4.3. *Note: Drift rates ($v$) were estimated using Response Coding. Positive values indicate evidence accumulation toward the 'Different' boundary; negative values indicate accumulation toward the 'Same' boundary.*"
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-pos: "htbp"
#| out-width: "90%"

library(patchwork)

drift_pooled <- pred_params %>%
  filter(model == PRIMARY_MODEL, rt_type == PRIMARY_RT, threshold == PRIMARY_THR) %>%
  group_by(difficulty, effort) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(difficulty, effort, drift_median, drift_q2.5, drift_q97.5) %>%
  mutate(difficulty = factor(difficulty, levels = c("Standard", "Easy", "Hard")),
         effort = factor(effort, levels = c("Low", "High")))

p_drift_pooled <- ggplot(drift_pooled, aes(x = difficulty, y = drift_median, color = effort, group = effort)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = drift_q2.5, ymax = drift_q97.5), position = position_dodge(width = 0.35), size = 0.7, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(width = 0.35), alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Low" = "#5DADE2", "High" = "#A23B72"), name = "Effort") +
  labs(x = "Difficulty", y = "Drift Rate (v)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13), legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "none",
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "gray40", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE)

boundary_pooled <- pred_params %>%
  filter(model == PRIMARY_MODEL, rt_type == PRIMARY_RT, threshold == PRIMARY_THR) %>%
  group_by(difficulty, effort) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(difficulty, effort, a_median, a_q2.5, a_q97.5) %>%
  mutate(difficulty = factor(difficulty, levels = c("Standard", "Easy", "Hard")),
         effort = factor(effort, levels = c("Low", "High")))

p_boundary_pooled <- ggplot(boundary_pooled, aes(x = difficulty, y = a_median, color = effort, group = effort)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = a_q2.5, ymax = a_q97.5), position = position_dodge(width = 0.35), size = 0.7, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(width = 0.35), alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Low" = "#5DADE2", "High" = "#A23B72"), name = "Effort") +
  labs(x = "Difficulty", y = "Boundary Separation (a)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13), legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "none",
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "gray40", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE)

fig_ddm_combined <- p_drift_pooled + p_boundary_pooled +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A", tag_prefix = "(", tag_suffix = ")",
                  theme = theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"))) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(fig_ddm_combined)
dir.create("output/figures", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave("output/figures/fig_ddm_parameters_combined.png", fig_ddm_combined, width = 12, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

Because Effort is a within-subject manipulation, visual overlap in marginal means is misleading. Plotting the posterior distribution of the difference score (High $-$ Low Effort) explicitly demonstrates that the 95% HDI does not cross zero, confirming a highly credible reduction in drift rate (@fig-effort-drift-posterior-diff).

```{r}
#| label: fig-effort-drift-posterior-diff
#| fig-cap: "Bayesian Hypothesis Test: Effort Effect on Drift Rate (H1). Posterior distribution of the High $-$ Low effort contrast on drift rate ($v$), extracted from the primary model. The 95% credible interval (CrI; shaded region) falls entirely below zero, supporting H1 ($\\delta$ = −0.07, 95% CrI [−0.11, −0.03], $P(\\delta < 0) > .999$)."
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-pos: "htbp"
#| out-width: "55%"
#| fig-height: 3

model_path_effort <- file.path(proj_root, params$run_dir, "models",
                                "additive__probe_onset_locked__thr0.20.rds")

if (file.exists(model_path_effort) &&
    requireNamespace("brms", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("posterior", quietly = TRUE)) {
  tryCatch({
    suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(brms); library(posterior) })
    fit_eff <- readRDS(model_path_effort)
    d_eff <- posterior::as_draws_df(fit_eff)

    # brms names the High-vs-Low coefficient b_effort_conditionhigh
    eff_var <- intersect(c("b_effort_conditionhigh", "b_effort_conditionHigh",
                           "b_effort_conditionhigh_mvc", "b_effort_conditionHigh40MVC"),
                         names(d_eff))[1]

    if (!is.na(eff_var)) {
      diff_draws <- as.numeric(d_eff[[eff_var]])
      hdi_lo <- quantile(diff_draws, 0.025)
      hdi_hi <- quantile(diff_draws, 0.975)
      med_val <- median(diff_draws)

      eff_df  <- tibble::tibble(diff = diff_draws)
      hdi_tbl <- tibble::tibble(lo = hdi_lo, hi = hdi_hi, med = med_val)

      p_eff <- ggplot(eff_df, aes(x = diff)) +
        geom_density(fill = "#A23B72", alpha = 0.55, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = 0,       linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.6) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = hdi_lo,  linetype = "dashed", color = "#A23B72", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.9) +
        geom_vline(xintercept = hdi_hi,  linetype = "dashed", color = "#A23B72", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.9) +
        geom_segment(data = hdi_tbl,
                     aes(x = lo, xend = hi, y = -Inf, yend = -Inf),
                     color = "black", linewidth = 0.9, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
        geom_point(data = hdi_tbl, aes(x = med, y = 0),
                   shape = 21, fill = "white", color = "black", size = 1.5,
                   inherit.aes = FALSE) +
        labs(x = "Drift rate contrast: High - Low Effort (link scale)",
             y = "Posterior density") +
        theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
        theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
              axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
      print(p_eff)
    } else {
      message("Effort contrast coefficient not found in model draws; skipping plot.")
      invisible(NULL)
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Effort posterior diff plot failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    invisible(NULL)
  })
} else {
  message("Model or required packages not found; skipping effort posterior diff plot.")
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-difficulty-contrasts
#| fig-cap: "**Bayesian Hypothesis Tests: Pairwise Difficulty Contrasts on Drift Rate (left) and Boundary Separation (right).** Each panel shows the posterior density of the named difference score extracted from the primary model. Vertical dashed lines mark zero; shaded bands show the 95% credible interval. No contrast crosses zero, confirming statistically credible effects of difficulty on both parameters. These posterior distributions serve as the formal Bayesian tests for the difficulty manipulation."
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-pos: "htbp"
#| out-width: "90%"
#| fig-height: 4

library(brms); library(posterior); library(tidybayes); library(ggplot2); library(patchwork)

model_path <- if (!is.null(params$run_dir) && length(params$run_dir) > 0) {
  file.path(proj_root, params$run_dir, "models",
            "additive__probe_onset_locked__thr0.20.rds")
} else {
  character(0)
}

if (length(model_path) > 0 && file.exists(model_path)) {
  fit <- readRDS(model_path)
  draws_df <- as_draws_df(fit)
  nn <- names(draws_df)

  # Detect drift rate difficulty columns (brms naming varies: difficulty_3, difficultylevel, difficulty_level)
  v_easy_col <- intersect(c("b_difficulty_3Easy", "b_difficultylevelEasy", "b_difficulty_levelEasy"), nn)[1]
  v_hard_col <- intersect(c("b_difficulty_3Hard", "b_difficultylevelHard", "b_difficulty_levelHard"), nn)[1]
  a_easy_col <- intersect(c("b_bs_difficulty_3Easy", "b_bs_difficultylevelEasy", "b_bs_difficulty_levelEasy"), nn)[1]
  a_hard_col <- intersect(c("b_bs_difficulty_3Hard", "b_bs_difficultylevelHard", "b_bs_difficulty_levelHard"), nn)[1]

  if (!is.na(v_easy_col) && !is.na(v_hard_col) && !is.na(a_easy_col) && !is.na(a_hard_col)) {
    # Drift rate difficulty contrasts (link scale)
    easy_std_v  <- draws_df[[v_easy_col]]
    hard_std_v  <- draws_df[[v_hard_col]]
    easy_hard_v <- draws_df[[v_easy_col]] - draws_df[[v_hard_col]]

    # Boundary separation difficulty contrasts (log link)
    easy_std_a  <- draws_df[[a_easy_col]]
    hard_std_a  <- draws_df[[a_hard_col]]
    easy_hard_a <- draws_df[[a_easy_col]] - draws_df[[a_hard_col]]

    contrast_data_v <- tibble::tibble(
      contrast = rep(c("Easy vs. Standard", "Hard vs. Standard", "Easy vs. Hard"),
                     each = length(easy_std_v)),
      value    = c(easy_std_v, hard_std_v, easy_hard_v)
    ) |> dplyr::mutate(contrast = factor(contrast,
          levels = c("Easy vs. Standard", "Hard vs. Standard", "Easy vs. Hard")))

    contrast_data_a <- tibble::tibble(
      contrast = rep(c("Easy vs. Standard", "Hard vs. Standard", "Easy vs. Hard"),
                     each = length(easy_std_a)),
      value    = c(easy_std_a, hard_std_a, easy_hard_a)
    ) |> dplyr::mutate(contrast = factor(contrast,
          levels = c("Easy vs. Standard", "Hard vs. Standard", "Easy vs. Hard")))

    p_v <- ggplot(contrast_data_v, aes(x = value, fill = contrast, color = contrast)) +
      geom_density(alpha = 0.45, linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.7) +
      facet_wrap(~contrast, scales = "free", ncol = 1) +
      scale_fill_manual(values  = c("#5DADE2","#A23B72","#2ECC71"), guide = "none") +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("#5DADE2","#A23B72","#2ECC71"), guide = "none") +
      labs(x = "Posterior difference (link scale)", y = "Density",
           title = expression(paste("Drift Rate ", italic(v), " Contrasts"))) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
      theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(size = 9))

    p_a <- ggplot(contrast_data_a, aes(x = value, fill = contrast, color = contrast)) +
      geom_density(alpha = 0.45, linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.7) +
      facet_wrap(~contrast, scales = "free", ncol = 1) +
      scale_fill_manual(values  = c("#5DADE2","#A23B72","#2ECC71"), guide = "none") +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("#5DADE2","#A23B72","#2ECC71"), guide = "none") +
      labs(x = "Posterior difference (log scale)", y = "Density",
           title = expression(paste("Boundary Sep. ", italic(a), " Contrasts"))) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
      theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(size = 9))

    print(p_v + p_a + plot_layout(ncol = 2))
  } else {
    message("Difficulty contrast columns not found in model; skipping fig-difficulty-contrasts.")
    invisible(NULL)
  }
} else {
  message("Model path not available or file not found; skipping difficulty contrasts figure.")
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-bias-by-task-effort

# Prepare data for bias plot
bias_plot_data <- pred_params %>%
  filter(model == PRIMARY_MODEL, rt_type == PRIMARY_RT, threshold == PRIMARY_THR) %>%

  select(task, effort, z_median, z_q2.5, z_q97.5) %>%

  )

geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = z_q2.5, xmax = z_q97.5),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.4), size = 0.6, linewidth = 0.5) +

    y = "Task",
    x = "Starting-Point Bias (z)",
    title = NULL
  ) +

ggsave("figures/fig_bias_by_task_effort.png", p_bias, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ddm-bias-by-task-effort
#| fig-pos: "H"
#| tbl-cap: "Starting-point bias ($z$) by Task $\\times$ Effort. Bias is constrained to be constant across difficulty levels (as trials are randomized). Values shown are collapsed across difficulty (median of medians). Values are posterior medians with 95% credible intervals."
#| tbl-pos: "htbp"
# Table B: bias z by Task × Effort (collapse across Difficulty since bias is constant)
ddm_bias <- pred_params %>%
  filter(model == PRIMARY_MODEL, rt_type == PRIMARY_RT, threshold == PRIMARY_THR) %>%
  filter(difficulty == "Standard") %>%  # Use Standard trials (bias is same across difficulty by design)
  select(task, effort, z_median, z_q2.5, z_q97.5) %>%
  mutate(
    task = factor(task, levels = c("ADT", "VDT")),
    effort = factor(effort, levels = c("Low", "High"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(task, effort) %>%
  mutate(
    `Bias (z)` = sprintf("%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]", z_median, z_q2.5, z_q97.5)
  ) %>%
  select(Task = task, Effort = effort, `Bias (z)`)

message(sprintf("ddm_bias table: %d rows (should be %d task × %d effort = %d)", 
                nrow(ddm_bias), 
                length(unique(pred_params$task)), 
                length(unique(pred_params$effort)),
                length(unique(pred_params$task)) * length(unique(pred_params$effort))))

ddm_bias %>%
  knitr::kable(format = ifelse(knitr::is_latex_output(), "latex", "html"), 
               booktabs = TRUE, 
               linesep = "",
               align = c("l", "l", "r")) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"),
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
    full_width = FALSE
  )
```

Together, these patterns show that task difficulty strongly modulates evidence accumulation ($v$) and caution ($a$), while bias ($z$) varies by task with minimal effort effects.

```{r pupil-quality-inline}
#| echo: false

# Compute pupil data quality metrics for inline use
if (exists("pupil_data") && !is.null(pupil_data) && nrow(pupil_data) > 0) {
  n_subj_pupil <- if ("subject_id" %in% names(pupil_data)) length(unique(pupil_data$subject_id)) else 0L
  n_trials_total <- nrow(pupil_data)
  mean_trials_per_subj <- if (n_subj_pupil > 0) round(n_trials_total / n_subj_pupil) else NA_real_
} else {
  n_subj_pupil <- 0L
  n_trials_total <- 0L
  mean_trials_per_subj <- NA_real_
}
pupil_quality_text <- if (n_subj_pupil > 0 && n_trials_total > 0) {
  suffix <- if (!is.na(mean_trials_per_subj))
    sprintf(" (mean %s trials per subject)", format(mean_trials_per_subj, big.mark = ","))
  else ""
  sprintf("Of %d subjects with usable pupil data, %s total trials had valid pupil recordings%s.",
    n_subj_pupil, format(n_trials_total, big.mark = ","), suffix)
} else {
  "Pupil data quality metrics could not be computed (data not loaded or empty)."
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-baseline-pupil
#| tbl-cap: "Baseline Pupil Diameter by Condition"
#| tbl-pos: "htbp"
# Compute baseline pupil diameter by task and effort
if (!is.null(pupil_data) && "baseline_B0" %in% names(pupil_data) && "task" %in% names(pupil_data) && "effort_condition" %in% names(pupil_data)) {
  baseline_pupil_summary <- pupil_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(baseline_B0), !is.na(task), !is.na(effort_condition)) %>%
    group_by(task, effort_condition, subject_id) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_baseline = mean(baseline_B0, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(task, effort_condition) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_baseline_mm = round(mean(mean_baseline, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      sd_baseline_mm = round(sd(mean_baseline, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      median_baseline_mm = round(median(mean_baseline, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      n_subjects = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Task_Group = case_when(
        task == "ADT" ~ "ADT",
        task == "VDT" ~ "VDT",
        TRUE ~ task
      ),
      Effort = case_when(
        effort_condition == "Low_5_MVC" ~ "Low (5% MVC)",
        effort_condition == "High_40_MVC" ~ "High (40% MVC)",
        TRUE ~ effort_condition
      ),
      `Mean (AU)` = mean_baseline_mm,
      `SD (AU)` = sd_baseline_mm,
      `Median (AU)` = median_baseline_mm,
      `N Subjects` = n_subjects
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Task_Group = gsub("\u2013", "-", Task_Group),
      Effort = gsub("\u2013", "-", Effort)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Task_Group, Effort) %>%
    select(Task_Group, Effort, `Mean (AU)`, `SD (AU)`, `Median (AU)`, `N Subjects`)
  
  baseline_pupil_summary %>%
    gt(groupname_col = "Task_Group") %>%
    fmt_number(columns = c(`Mean (AU)`, `SD (AU)`, `Median (AU)`), decimals = 2) %>%
    fmt_number(columns = `N Subjects`, decimals = 0) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      locations = cells_column_labels()
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold", style = "italic"),
      locations = cells_row_groups()
    ) %>%
    tab_options(
      row_group.as_column = FALSE,
      row_group.padding = px(8)
    ) %>%
    tab_footnote(
      footnote = "Baseline pupil diameter (tonic arousal) computed from pre-trial baseline window (-0.5s to 0s relative to squeeze onset). Values in arbitrary units (AU) from eye tracker.",
      locations = cells_column_labels(columns = `Mean (AU)`)
    )
} else {

        task == "ADT" ~ "ADT (Auditory Detection Task)",

      Effort = case_when(

      ),
      `Mean (AU)` = "To be computed",
      `SD (AU)` = "To be computed",
      `Median (AU)` = "To be computed",
      `N Subjects` = "To be computed"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Task_Group = gsub("\u2013", "-", Task_Group),

    ) %>%

    select(Task_Group, Effort, `Mean (AU)`, `SD (AU)`, `Median (AU)`, `N Subjects`)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-tepr
#| tbl-cap: "Task-Evoked Pupil Response (TEPR) by Condition"
#| tbl-pos: "htbp"
# Compute TEPR (cognitive AUC) by task, difficulty, and effort
if (!is.null(pupil_data) && "cognitive_auc" %in% names(pupil_data) && "task" %in% names(pupil_data) && "effort_condition" %in% names(pupil_data) && "difficulty_level" %in% names(pupil_data)) {
  tepr_summary <- pupil_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(cognitive_auc), !is.na(task), !is.na(effort_condition), !is.na(difficulty_level)) %>%
    group_by(task, difficulty_level, effort_condition, subject_id) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_cog_auc = mean(cognitive_auc, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(task, difficulty_level, effort_condition) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_auc = round(mean(mean_cog_auc, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      sd_auc = round(sd(mean_cog_auc, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      n_subjects = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Task_Group = case_when(
        task == "ADT" ~ "ADT",
        task == "VDT" ~ "VDT",
        TRUE ~ task
      ),
      Difficulty = case_when(
        difficulty_level == "Standard" ~ "Standard",
        difficulty_level == "Easy" ~ "Easy",
        difficulty_level == "Hard" ~ "Hard",
        TRUE ~ difficulty_level
      ),
      Effort = case_when(
        effort_condition == "Low_5_MVC" ~ "Low (5% MVC)",
        effort_condition == "High_40_MVC" ~ "High (40% MVC)",
        TRUE ~ effort_condition
      ),
      `Mean AUC` = mean_auc,
      `SD AUC` = sd_auc,
      `N Subjects` = n_subjects
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Task_Group = gsub("\u2013", "-", Task_Group),
      Difficulty = gsub("\u2013", "-", Difficulty),
      Effort = gsub("\u2013", "-", Effort)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Task_Group, Difficulty, Effort) %>%
    select(Task_Group, Difficulty, Effort, `Mean AUC`, `SD AUC`, `N Subjects`)
  
  # Note: Peak amplitude calculation would require time-series data
  # For now, we report AUC as the primary TEPR metric
  tepr_summary %>%
    gt(groupname_col = "Task_Group") %>%
    fmt_number(columns = c(`Mean AUC`, `SD AUC`), decimals = 3) %>%
    fmt_number(columns = `N Subjects`, decimals = 0) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      locations = cells_column_labels()
    ) %>%
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold", style = "italic"),
      locations = cells_row_groups()
    ) %>%
    tab_options(
      row_group.as_column = FALSE,
      row_group.padding = px(8)
    ) %>%
    tab_footnote(
      footnote = "TEPR (phasic arousal) quantified as Cognitive AUC (Area Under the Curve) from baseline-corrected pupil data using W3.0 window (4.65s to 7.65s, target+0.3s to target+3.3s). AUC in units of AU·s.",
      locations = cells_column_labels(columns = `Mean AUC`)
    )
} else {
  # Placeholder if data not available
  tepr_placeholder <- expand_grid(
    task = c("ADT", "VDT"),
    difficulty_level = c("Standard", "Easy", "Hard"),
    effort_condition = c("Low_5_MVC", "High_40_MVC")
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Task_Group = case_when(
        task == "ADT" ~ "ADT (Auditory Detection Task)",

      ),
      Difficulty = case_when(
        difficulty_level == "Standard" ~ "Standard",
        difficulty_level == "Easy" ~ "Easy",
        difficulty_level == "Hard" ~ "Hard",
        TRUE ~ difficulty_level
      ),
      Effort = case_when(
        effort_condition == "Low_5_MVC" ~ "Low (5% MVC)",
        effort_condition == "High_40_MVC" ~ "High (40% MVC)",
        TRUE ~ effort_condition
      ),
      `Mean AUC` = "To be computed",
      `SD AUC` = "To be computed",
      `N Subjects` = "To be computed"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Task_Group = gsub("\u2013", "-", Task_Group),
      Difficulty = gsub("\u2013", "-", Difficulty),
      Effort = gsub("\u2013", "-", Effort)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Task_Group, Difficulty, Effort) %>%
    select(Task_Group, Difficulty, Effort, `Mean AUC`, `SD AUC`, `N Subjects`)
  
  tepr_placeholder %>%
    gt(groupname_col = "Task_Group") %>%

    ) %>%
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-tepr-timecourse
#| fig-cap: "Task-Evoked Pupil Response (TEPR) Time Course. Grand-average pupil traces (baseline-corrected, mean ± 95% CI) aligned to squeeze onset for four conditions (Easy/Low, Easy/High, Hard/Low, Hard/High), separately for ADT (top) and VDT (bottom). The shaded region indicates the cognitive AUC window used for TEPR quantification (4.65s to 7.65s relative to squeeze onset, extending from 300ms after target stimulus onset until ~3s post-target). Baseline-corrected traces converge at 0 during the baseline period (-0.5 to 0s). Vertical dashed lines indicate key events: trial start (0s), target stimulus onset (4.35s), and response signal onset (4.7s)."
#| fig-align: center
#| out-width: "85%"
#| echo: false
# Generate TEPR time course figure
if (!is.null(pupil_data)) {
  # Try to load waveform summary data
  waveform_file <- file.path(proj_root, "quick_share_v7/analysis/pupil_waveforms_condition_mean.csv")
  
  if (file.exists(waveform_file)) {
    waveform_data <- read_csv(waveform_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
    
    # Filter to chapter 3 data and keep all 4 conditions (effort × difficulty)
    waveform_ch3 <- waveform_data %>%
      filter(chapter == "ch3") %>%
      # Map difficulty level from stimulus_intensity and isOddball
      mutate(
        difficulty_level = case_when(
          isOddball == 0 | (is.na(isOddball) & (!is.na(stimulus_intensity) & stimulus_intensity == 0)) ~ "Standard",
          !is.na(stimulus_intensity) & stimulus_intensity %in% c(1, 2) ~ "Hard",
          !is.na(stimulus_intensity) & stimulus_intensity %in% c(3, 4) ~ "Easy",
          isOddball == 1 & is.na(stimulus_intensity) ~ "Easy",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        ),
        effort_level = case_when(
          effort == "Low" | effort == "Low_Force_5pct" ~ "Low",
          effort == "High" | effort == "High_Force_40pct" ~ "High",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        ),
        # Create condition label (Difficulty / Effort)
        condition = case_when(
          !is.na(difficulty_level) & !is.na(effort_level) ~ 
            paste0(difficulty_level, " / ", effort_level),
          TRUE ~ "Unknown"
        )
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        difficulty_level = gsub("\u2013", "-", difficulty_level),
        effort_level = gsub("\u2013", "-", effort_level),
        condition = gsub("\u2013", "-", condition)
      ) %>%
      # Filter out Standard trials (we want Easy/Hard only) and Unknown
      filter(condition != "Unknown", !grepl("Standard", condition)) %>%
      # Use mean_pupil_full (baseline-corrected, B0-corrected) - this converges at 0 in baseline period
      # Per plot_pupil_waveforms.R line 134: mean_pupil_full is the B0-corrected (full baseline correction)
      rename(mean_pupil_isolated = mean_pupil_full) %>%
      # Group by task, condition, and time to get per-condition means
      group_by(task, condition, t_rel) %>%
      summarise(
        # Weighted mean across any duplicate entries (weight by n_trials)
        total_trials = sum(n_trials, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_pupil_isolated = sum(mean_pupil_isolated * n_trials, na.rm = TRUE) / total_trials,
        n_trials = total_trials,
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(task), !is.na(condition), !is.na(t_rel), !is.na(mean_pupil_isolated)) %>%
      arrange(task, condition, t_rel)
    
    if (nrow(waveform_ch3) > 0) {
      # Define event markers and cognitive AUC window
      # Based on Methods section: cognitive AUC window is 4.65s to 7.65s (300ms after target until 3.3s post-target)
      trial_start <- 0.0  # Trial start (squeeze onset)
      target_onset <- 4.35  # Target stimulus onset
      response_signal_onset <- 4.7  # Response signal onset
      cognitive_auc_start <- 4.65  # 300ms after target onset (4.35 + 0.3)
      cognitive_auc_end <- 7.65  # 3.3s post-target (4.35 + 3.3), which is the W3.0 window
      
      # Define color scheme for 4 conditions (matching plot_pupil_waveforms.R)
      condition_colors <- c(
        "Easy / Low" = "#5DADE2",    # Light blue
        "Easy / High" = "#2E86AB",   # Dark blue  
        "Hard / Low" = "#EC70AB",    # Light pink
        "Hard / High" = "#A23B72"    # Dark pink
      )
      
      # Get conditions actually present in data
      conditions_present <- unique(waveform_ch3$condition)
      conditions_present <- conditions_present[!is.na(conditions_present)]
      colors_for_plot <- condition_colors[names(condition_colors) %in% conditions_present]
      if (length(colors_for_plot) == 0) {
        # Fallback: use default colors if no matches
        colors_for_plot <- scales::hue_pal()(length(conditions_present))
        names(colors_for_plot) <- conditions_present
      }
      
      # Calculate y-limits from data (use full range to show all curves, add padding for labels)
      y_vals <- waveform_ch3$mean_pupil_isolated[!is.na(waveform_ch3$mean_pupil_isolated)]
      if (length(y_vals) > 0) {
        # Use full range to ensure all curves are visible
        y_range <- range(y_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
        y_range_span <- diff(y_range)
        if (!is.finite(y_range_span) || y_range_span == 0) {
          y_range_span <- max(abs(y_range), na.rm = TRUE)
          if (!is.finite(y_range_span) || y_range_span == 0) y_range_span <- 1
        }
        # Add padding (12% top, 8% bottom) to accommodate labels and ensure visibility
        y_upper_limit <- y_range[2] + y_range_span * 0.12  # Extra space for labels
        y_lower_limit <- y_range[1] - y_range_span * 0.08  # Padding at bottom
      } else {
        y_upper_limit <- 0.5
        y_lower_limit <- -0.5
        y_range_span <- 1  # Default span for label positioning
      }
      
      # Event markers with staggered y positions to avoid overlap (vertical text)
      event_markers <- tibble(
        event = c("Trial Start", "Target", "Response"),
        time = c(trial_start, target_onset, response_signal_onset),
        label_y = y_upper_limit - y_range_span * c(0.05, 0.10, 0.15)  # Stagger vertically
      )
      
      # Create plot
      p_tepr <- ggplot(waveform_ch3, aes(x = t_rel, y = mean_pupil_isolated, 
                                         color = condition, fill = condition)) +
        # Cognitive AUC window shading
        geom_rect(aes(xmin = cognitive_auc_start, xmax = cognitive_auc_end, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
                  inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "grey90", alpha = 0.3) +
        # GAM smoothed lines with confidence intervals
        geom_smooth(se = TRUE, method = "gam", formula = y ~ s(x, k = 20), 
                    linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.3) +
        # Event markers (vertical dashed lines)
        geom_vline(data = event_markers, aes(xintercept = time), 
                   inherit.aes = FALSE, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.6) +
        # Event labels (vertical text to avoid overlap)
        geom_text(data = event_markers, aes(x = time, y = label_y, label = event),
                  inherit.aes = FALSE, angle = 90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.9,
                  size = 3.5, color = "grey20", fontface = "bold") +
        # Facet by task (stacked vertically)
        facet_wrap(~task, ncol = 1, labeller = labeller(task = c("ADT" = "ADT", 
                                                                  "VDT" = "VDT"))) +
        # Scales
        scale_color_manual(values = colors_for_plot, name = "Condition") +
        scale_fill_manual(values = colors_for_plot, name = "Condition") +
        scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-0.5, 8, 1), expand = c(0, 0.1)) +
        coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_lower_limit, y_upper_limit)) +
        # Labels and theme
        labs(
          x = "Time (s, relative to squeeze onset)",
          y = "Baseline-Corrected Pupil Diameter (AU)",
          title = NULL
        ) +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
        theme(
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.5),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = NA),
          legend.position = "bottom",

        )

    } else {

    }

  }
} else {
```
